handoffSentence.en-IN: What you've shared sounds serious. Please call one of these numbers now and talk to a person.
handoffSentence.hi-Latn: Aapne jo bataya woh serious lagta hai. Please abhi inme se kisi ek number par call karke kisi insaan se baat karein.

diagnosis.en-IN: I can't diagnose, but I can help you find someone who can.
diagnosis.hi-Latn: Yahan diagnosis nahi kiya ja sakta, lekin aise expert dhoondhne mein madad ho sakti hai jo diagnosis kar sakein.

medical.en-IN: I can't advise on medicines or doses. A psychiatrist or doctor can, and I can help you find one.
medical.hi-Latn: Dawaiyon ya dose par yahan salah nahi di ja sakti. Psychiatrist ya doctor yeh bata sakte hain, aur unhe dhoondhne mein madad ho sakti hai.

claims_human.en-IN: I'm an AI assistant, not a person.
claims_human.hi-Latn: Main ek AI assistant hoon, koi insaan nahi.

understand.en-IN: Before suggesting anything, it helps to understand a bit more. What's been weighing on you most?
understand.hi-Latn: Kuch suggest karne se pehle thoda aur samajhna madadgaar hoga. Aapko sabse zyada kya pareshan kar raha hai?

recommend.en-IN: Based on what you've shared, these kinds of help may fit.
recommend.hi-Latn: Aapne jo bataya uske hisaab se, is tarah ki madad aapke liye sahi ho sakti hai.

close.en-IN: Take your time with these. You can open any of them, or delete this conversation below.
close.hi-Latn: Aaram se dekhiye. Aap inme se koi bhi khol sakte hain, ya neeche yeh conversation delete kar sakte hain.

notEnoughYet.en-IN: I don't know enough yet to suggest a specific kind of help, so here are two general places to start: self-care tools, and talking with a therapist.
notEnoughYet.hi-Latn: Abhi itni jaankari nahi hai ki koi khaas tarah ki madad suggest ki ja sake, isliye shuru karne ke liye yeh do general options hain: self-care tools, aur kisi therapist se baat karna.

conversation_turns.en-IN: Each conversation is limited to 20 of your messages. You can start a new one.
conversation_turns.hi-Latn: Ek conversation mein aapke 20 messages tak ki limit hai. Aap naya conversation shuru kar sakte hain.

daily_conversations.en-IN: This demo allows 5 conversations a day, because it runs on paid AI services. The limit resets at midnight India time.
daily_conversations.hi-Latn: Yeh demo paid AI services par chalta hai, isliye din mein 5 conversations ki limit hai. Yeh limit raat 12 baje (India time) reset hoti hai.

hourly_turns.en-IN: This demo allows 30 messages an hour, because it runs on paid AI services. The limit resets within the hour.
hourly_turns.hi-Latn: Yeh demo paid AI services par chalta hai, isliye ek ghante mein 30 messages ki limit hai. Yeh limit ek ghante ke andar reset ho jaayegi.

spend.en-IN: This demo has used today's budget for its paid AI services. The budget resets at midnight India time.
spend.hi-Latn: Is demo ka aaj ka paid AI services ka budget khatam ho gaya hai. Budget raat 12 baje (India time) reset hota hai.
